Synapse 1.166.0 with the fixed Twisted it ships itself, Element Web 1.12.36 and Matrix Authentication Service 1.30.0.

## 🎨 Design

- The download buttons in the README are a little larger, and a row that wraps on a narrow screen stays centred, in Firefox as well.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Fresh building blocks.** element-hq/synapse 1.166.0, vectorim/element-web 1.12.36 and element-hq/matrix-authentication-service 1.30.0.
- **Synapse [v1.166.0](https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/releases/tag/v1.166.0)** fixes remote media downloads that failed or left empty files behind, memberships missing from sync, and 500 errors when leaving, inviting or kicking in some rooms.
- **Element Web [v1.12.36](https://github.com/element-hq/element-web/releases/tag/v1.12.36)** shows document previews outside of labs, lets you rejoin an Element Call after a reload, and checks the recovery key right in the sign-out dialog.
- **Twisted, authlib, joserfc and pyasn1 come from Synapse again.** Synapse 1.166.0 ships Twisted 26.10.0 with the fix for the HTTP/2 denial-of-service advisory, and the other three without open advisories, so the image no longer installs its own copies. soupsieve, tornado, setuptools and pip are still replaced.
